805.title: New accommodation available now!
805.excerpt: As promised yesterday, we are delivering! From now on, you can find 11 new hotels, Brutal Motel, Van/Caravan parking, and Car by Tent at Parking 2 on our e-shop. Please note that this year there will be no Van/Caravan parking at Parking 3, and you will not have the option to set up your own tents at Camp Dagon. The capacities of the hotels and parking areas currently listed will not be increased further, so we strongly recommend getting yours without delay!Accommodation: https://brutalassault.cz

801.title: Accommodation and parking now available!
801.excerpt: The moment you've been waiting for is here – the first drop of accommodation and parking for Brutal Assault 2027 is now on our e-shop! Camps, hotels, Brutal Motel, Pentaville, plus parking for cars, motorcycles, and vans are all available. There's simply something for everyone, but capacities will sell out fast – we recommend not hesitating.Accommodation: https://brutalassault.cz/en/accommodationParking: https://brutalassault.cz/en/tc-66/parking ...

799.title: Natural Stand, VIP Lodge and Lockerboxes available now!
799.excerpt: It's here – the Natural Stand, both VIP lounges, and lockerboxes are now on sale! We highly recommend acting quickly, as these are exactly the items that tend to disappear before you can even say "progressive technical death metal."But as promised, we aren't stopping there – this Wednesday, we will be launching the sale of select camps, hotels, other accommodation options and parkings!Get yours here: https://brutalassault.cz/en/tickets ...

797.title: Master’s Hammer will perform at Brutal Assault 2027!
797.excerpt: Ritual live in its entirety. For the double anniversary—40 years of the band and 35 years since the release of the cult album—the band has prepared a unique full-length performance of Ritual, along with a few new tracks.Master's Hammer stood at the genesis of a dark, theatrical, purely endemic, and timeless aesthetic that influences generations of bands worldwide. 807.excerpt: Don't have your ticket for the jubilee 30th edition of Brutal Assault yet? You can get them at the current price until today at 23:59:59 CEST!
